prompt: This lock passes a quick test with interrupts enabled, but it can still deadlock against a timer handler that takes the same lock, and it breaks callers that already had interrupts off. Tap the line that causes both problems.
explain: `sti` runs while the lock is still held, so a pending timer interrupt can fire immediately and its handler spins on `held == 1` forever. It also enables interrupts unconditionally, ignoring `flags`; a caller that had them off (or holds a second lock) wakes up with them on. Release first, then `irq_restore(flags)`.
